infobox.usage: - Unlocks apartment 2 on the second floor of the Cardinal apartment complex on Streets of Tarkov. - Unlocks the locked bedroom in apartment 2 on the second floor of the Cardinal apartment complex on Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Cardinal apartment key (Cardinal) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to an apartment in a luxury residential complex. These apartments once housed TerraGroup's senior executives.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: The Lab
sections.text: In the safe inside Kruglov's office. A single key is guaranteed to spawn every raid.

sections.heading: Lock Locations
sections.text: Doors to apartment 2 and its locked bedroom on the second floor of the Cardinal apartment complex at Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- 2x Sports bag
- 1x PC block
- 2x Toolbox
- 2x Safe (locked)
- 1x Weapon locker
- Loose loot (Valuables, Medical items, , Provisions, Other items)
- Locked bedroom:
  - Loose loot (Valuables)
  - 1x Sports bag
  - 1x Safe (locked) requiring TerraGroup Labs keycard (Black) to be swiped at the keycard panel behind the painting, while no use gets consumed

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: The painting in the bedroom depicts "The Last Day of Pompeii" from Karl Pavlovich Bryullov.
